content.title: Why US data centers are concentrated in the 'rodeo region'
content.description:
Big Tech companies, like Alphabet (GOOG, GOOGL), Oracle (ORCL), and OpenAI (OPAI.PVT) are betting on the central US, otherwise known as the "rodeo region."

Bow River Capital vice chairman, economist, and chief strategy officer Rick Pederson joins Asking for a Trend to discuss why this region has become a key focus in the AI era.

To watch more expert insights and analysis on the latest market action, check out more Asking for a Trend.

content.title: Stock market today: Dow, S&P 500, Nasdaq slide as sell-off resumes ahead of Nvidia earnings, jobs data
Here's why today's top stocks rarely stay the market leaders
Dow falls 400 points, Alphabet touches an all-time high
content.description:
Here are some of the top stories Wall Street is watching on Monday, Nov. 17. Stocks are extending their losses heading into late-afternoon trading, with the Dow Jones Industrial Average (^DJI) shedding more than 400 points. One stock bucking the trend is Alphabet (GOOG, GOOGL), which is getting a boost from Berkshire Hathaway (BRK-B, BRK-A) taking a stake in the tech giant. XPeng (XPEV) shares are falling after issuing a disappointing revenue outlook.

Stay up to date on the latest market action, minute-by-minute, with Yahoo Finance's Market Minute.
